children: IFS, a provider of Industrial AI software, has announced that Arab Tank Terminals (ATTL), an independent bulk liquid storage terminal operator on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea coast, has selected IFS Cloud embedded with IFS.ai as its enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform.
The implementation will provide ATTL with a unified technology platform covering finance, procurement, supply chain, maintenance, asset management, projects, HSE and human resources.
The company expects the system to improve operational visibility, data accuracy and workflow efficiency while supporting faster decision-making and future growth.
ATTL is a joint venture between Saudi Arabian Refineries Company (SARCO), Independent Petroleum Group (IPG) and Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC).
IFS Cloud, powered by IFS.ai, uses machine learning and historical trends to provide operational insights and support productivity.

Rahul Misra, SVP & Managing Director - Middle East and Africa at IFS, said: “In an asset intensive organisation such as Arab Tank Terminals Ltd, IFS Cloud that works on the operational intelligence of IFS.ai will help move from isolated signals to a single connected workflow. It will help teams detect issues earlier, respond faster and thereby optimise performance. We look forward to working with ATTL on their digital transformation journey.”

The platform is also expected to help ATTL strengthen asset reliability and maintenance planning, improve inventory and procurement processes, enhance regulatory compliance and safety procedures, and gain real-time operational insights.

Abdulaziz Albakr, Chairman of the Board of Directors, Arab Tank Terminals, said: “Investing in a platform like IFS Cloud is an investment in ATTL's future. It gives our people the visibility, reliability and tools to operate at the highest standards, and lays the digital foundation for the next phase of ATTL's growth.”
ATTL selected IFS Cloud for its capabilities in asset and maintenance management, HSE and its ability to provide a unified platform for critical business operations.
The announcement adds to IFS’s growing presence in the Middle East, where the company has developed a customer portfolio across several core industries.

title: ZAWYA: Arab Tank Terminals selects IFS Cloud for digital transformation
